title: Adopt Celery worker pool with RabbitMQ broker
rationale: We must use `celery` with `rabbitmq` message broker for distributed task execution. Rejected alternative: direct `multiprocessing` worker spawning was rejected because unmanaged subprocesses leak file descriptors and cannot distribute work across multiple nodes. Also rejected `raw_thread_pool` which stalled under GIL saturation.
alternatives_considered: Direct multiprocessing worker spawning with shared queue

title: Standardize on RabbitMQ for message broker persistence
rationale: Adopt `rabbitmq` for persistent message delivery guarantees. Rejected alternative: `zeromq` socket mesh was turned down because peer-to-peer brokerless messaging drops unacknowledged messages when subscriber nodes restart.

title: Implement exponential jittered backoff for task retry logic
rationale: All task retry policies must implement `exponential_backoff` with randomized jitter. Rejected alternative: fixed `busy_spin_loop` retry was rejected because it causes thundering herd problems and exhausts database connections.

title: Use Protocol Buffers for task payload serialization
rationale: Payloads must be serialized using `protobuf` schema. Rejected alternative: `pickle_serializer` is strictly forbidden due to arbitrary remote code execution vulnerabilities in untrusted payloads.
